claims.claim: Infleqtion has material customer and receivables concentration that makes near-term revenue and cash conversion sensitive to a small number of counterparties: its May 2026 prospectus reports one customer represented 61% of Q1 2026 revenue, while two customers represented 74% and 19% of accounts receivable at March 31, 2026.

This concentration is an observed underwriting risk rather than a present business blocker; resilience would improve if subsequent filings show broader customer/revenue dispersion and reduced receivables concentration while commercial revenue scales.

risks.risk: A small number of customers account for a large share of revenue and receivables, increasing exposure to contract timing, renewal, collection and procurement changes.

unknowns.unknown: Current post-Q1 customer and receivables concentration is not established by this source and should be refreshed by Alpha from the latest filing before numeric underwriting.

falsifier: A newer primary filing showing materially diversified revenue and receivables would weaken this concentration-risk interpretation and should supersede it for current underwriting.
